placements.title: Switching Analytics Pipelines to Specialized High-Performance Database Engines
placements.frame: what performance gains, licensing economics, and delivery milestones justify migrating analytics pipelines from general-purpose databases to specialized infrastructure?
placements.why: Dave Quantum announces the technical rationale (10x query performance, lower licensing cost) for moving the analytics pipeline from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB, and Xena documents the decision specifics and Q3 2026 timeline target.
